title: Agentic AutoSurvey: Let Agentic LLM Survey LLMs

contributions.purpose: 用多智能体流水线自动生成文献综述
contributions.mechanism: 四专职 agent(Paper Search / Topic Mining & Clustering / Academic Survey Writer / Quality Evaluator)经 Claude Code 编排;检索 20-30 变体查询,MiniLM 嵌入+K-means(轮廓分选 K)聚类
contributions.evaluation: 6 个 COLM 2024 主题,处理 75-443 篇/主题(共 847 篇),15-20 分钟成稿,引用覆盖 80%+
contributions.domain: 自动文献综述/LLM 多智能体
contributions.source_quote: Our system employs four specialised agents working in concert to generate comprehensive literature surveys with superior synthesis quality.

contributions.purpose: 提供比传统指标更细的综述质量评估
contributions.mechanism: 12 维 agent-as-judge 评估框架(Core 60%/Writing 20%/Depth 20%)替代规则评分
contributions.evaluation: 12 维评分,0-10 分制,对标 ACM Computing Surveys(10,000+ 词/100+ 引用)等发表标准
contributions.source_quote: a comprehensive 12-dimensional evaluation framework providing nuanced, context-aware quality assessment.

contributions.purpose: 论证多智能体优于现有自动综述
contributions.mechanism: 与 AutoSurvey 基线在 6 主题上对比
contributions.evaluation: 本系统均分 8.18/10 vs AutoSurvey 4.77/10(+71%);Core 维 +99%、Writing +68%、Depth +33%
contributions.source_quote: our multi-agent approach achieves significant improvements over existing baselines, scoring 8.18/10 compared to AutoSurvey's 4.77/10.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our framework expands evaluation from previous 5-dimensional approaches to a comprehensive 12-dimensional framework.

notes: 数据红旗:比较严重偏置——用自家的 agent-as-judge(LLM 评审)同时给两系统打分,且 AutoSurvey 基线由本文自行重实现并换成更弱的 Meta-Llama-3.1-8B(‘due to budget constraints’),即 nerfed/simulated baseline,故 +71% 增益不可信;Table 2 无误差棒,但 checklist#7 声称‘results include error bars across multiple runs’(无据);Table 1 对‘Ours’全打勾自吹。AI 自我披露风险高度相关:checklist 承认‘can hallucinate fake results when attempting end-to-end tasks’‘models often resort to placeholders’——恰好指向综述/分数可能被编造。代码‘will be made available’(尚未)。trade-off:RLHF 主题 443 篇→7.74 vs 最优规模 8.43,暴露可扩展性瓶颈。checklist:设计/分析/写作自评 [C]。reject。
